**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen (e.g. new cloud provider mapping, additional CAD title block options, multi-region failover simulator).

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Architectural / Technical Details**
Any relevant architectural standards (ISO, NIST, CIS Benchmark, RFC) or TypeScript/React implementation ideas.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, diagrams, or mockups about the feature request here.
